messages:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up — FinEdge fed us a long preflight. They require customer-managed keys (BYOK) using their nCipher HSM, offline key import option, signed attestation artifact for auditors, and minimum 7-year key rotation logs retention. Need a quick pre-POC feasibility call. POC is Wed 08:30 PT.

Priya (solutions): Quick take: we support nCipher via PKCS#11 and via wrapped-key import (AES-KW). Offline import OK if customer provides a wrapped key blob + signed manifest. For on-prem HSMs we do a handshake with a two-person custodian flow. Will draft a sample manifest and terraform snippet.

Omar (security): Questions we need answered from customer: desired FIPS level (they mentioned FIPS 140-3), HSM firmware baseline, and whether the HSM provides anti-tamper logs. Regarding retention: our default audit log retention for key ops is 1 year; extended retention to 7 years is possible as an add-on (SLA + storage charge). Also need to clarify whether they want full plaintext key history (we never log plaintext) or only operation metadata.

Ben (finance): preliminary cost model we can give now: one-time BYOK onboarding fee $8,500 (includes attestation artifact & verification), plus 25% uplift on Dedicated slot pricing for HSM-backed capacity, and $0.015 per key op for KMS-heavy workloads. Extended retention is $0.10/GB/month in archived secure storage; I'll confirm exact numbers for the quote.

Priya (solutions): sample manifest draft to include in runbook:
```
manifest_v1:
  customer_id: "finedge-1234"
  key_id: "rek-2026-01"
  wrap_alg: "AES-KW"
  wrapping_key_id: "cust-kek-01"
  import_method: "offline"
  signature: "<base64-sig>"
```
We should also include instructions for verifying the signature client-side (openssl/age example).

Maya (Sales): auditor asked if attestation can be produced prior to the live POC so they can pre-clear. Can we do that?

Omar (security): We can produce a pre-provision attestation packet based on HSM certs + hashed manifest. That artifact will be signed by our signing key and include the HSM vendor cert chain. Note: for full attestation we need the device to be online once to capture runtime measurements; pre-provision will be a cert + vendor attestation snapshot. We'll call that an "attestation snapshot" and mark it in SOW.

Priya (solutions): networking specifics: runtime nodes need to reach customer HSM on 8443/TCP (mutual TLS) and we require outbound 443 to control-plane. If the HSM sits on customer network, recommend VPC peering and a NAT for control-plane egress. Example snippet for terraform (security group):
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "hsm_ingress" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 8443
  to_port     = 8443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.200.0.0/16"]
}
```
Also remind them to open 4500/UDP if IPsec tunnel is used.

Ben (finance): adding: expedite attestation prep has an extra rush fee of $1,200 if they need same-day signed packet. Otherwise standard lead time is 3 business days.

Omar (security): retention SOW language suggestion: "Redwood retains KMS operation metadata and rotation metadata for X years. No customer plaintext key material is ever stored. Extended archival retention available upon request and billed separately." Need legal to sign off on exact phrasing.

Priya (solutions): one more technical: we support rotating a keyset with zero downtime using a shadow-key rollout; but if they want immediate hard cutover we need a short traffic quiesce window (~30s) for cache invalidation.

Maya (Sales): action items: Priya — post manifest + terraform snippet to runbook and share with FinEdge; Omar — draft attestation snapshot template + SOW retention language; Ben — firm quote and uplift numbers for the pricing sheet incl. rush fee. I'll schedule an internal precall tomorrow 09:00 PT.

OnboardBot: Created pre-POC checklist: manifest draft, attestation template, network snippet, finance estimate.

Priya (solutions): FYI if customer insists on FIPS 140-3 certified HSM module at L3 we will need vendor model and firmware — flagging a potential blocker until they confirm model.

Ben (finance): I'll drop preliminary line items into the deal doc and mark provisional until security confirms.

Maya (Sales): thanks all. I'll send the questionnaire to the customer and try to get the HSM model before the internal call.
